# 🐳 Dockerfile Optimizer / Dockerfile 智能优化

> Analyze and rewrite Dockerfiles for smaller size, faster builds, and better layer caching. / 分析并重写 Dockerfile，实现更小镜像、更快构建和最佳层缓存。

> 🦁 **由 KingAI.Work 出品** — 智能进化｜vip@kingai.work

---

## The Problem / 痛点

Manual Dockerfile Optimizer / Dockerfile 智能优化 takes too long. This tool automates it.

## The Solution / 方案

• Automatically detects inefficient COPY and RUN order to maximize Docker layer caching / 智能识别COPY与RUN指令顺序问题，优化层缓存策略，大幅减少重复构建时间
• Merges multiple RUN commands into one to reduce intermediate image layers / 自动合并多条RUN指令为单条，精简中间层，镜像体积直降30%+
• Identifies and removes unnecessary apt-get clean, npm cache, or pip cache duplication / 精准识别并清除冗余包管理缓存，杜绝无意义镜像膨胀
• Suggests multi-stage builds with dependency separation for production-ready images / 推荐多阶段构建方案，分离编译与运行环境，生成生产级超轻量镜像
• (Pro) Auto-rewrites FROM instructions to use minimal base like alpine or distroless / 高阶版自动替换基础镜像为极简版本，如alpine或distroless，安全与体积兼得
• (Pro) Integrates security scan after optimization to flag known CVEs in base images / 高级版集成镜像安全扫描，优化后自动检测基础镜像已知漏洞

## Get Started / 上手

```bash
dockerfile-optimizer rewrite ./Dockerfile --output ./Dockerfile.optimized Rewrites the Dockerfile in-place following best practices for layer ordering and command merging. / 原地重写Dockerfile，按最佳实践调整层顺序并合并指令，构建效率立竿见影。 
```

## Real Scenarios / 实际场景

• CI pipeline builds taking 5+ minutes: Optimizer restructures layer ordering so code changes rarely bust the entire cache / CI流水线构建耗时5分钟以上：优化器重排层顺序后，仅代码修改不影响缓存，构建缩短至1分钟
• Bloated production images over 500MB: Multi-stage suggestion and cache cleanup reduce image to under 150MB / 生产镜像超过500MB：多阶段构建建议加缓存清理，镜像瘦身至150MB以下
• Onboarding new developers with slow local builds: Single-command rewrite restores fast iteration cycles / 新开发者本地构建缓慢：单条命令重写Dockerfile，恢复秒级迭代体验
